title: Tabular Foundation Models Can Do Survival Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2601.22259v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While tabular foundation models have achieved remarkable success in classification and regression, adapting them to model time-to-event outcomes for survival analysis is non-trivial due to right-censoring, where data observations may end before the event of interest occurs. In this work, we systematically study a variety of approaches to utilize off-the-shelf tabular foundation models originally designed for classification for discrete-time survival modeling. We evaluate existing classification formulations, including hazard modeling and multi-class classification approaches, and introduce a new formulation that directly models cumulative failure probabilities at discretized time points, treating censored observations as examples with missing labels at certain time points. translated_title: 表格基础模型可以进行生存分析
translated_abstract: 尽管表格基础模型在分类和回归任务中已取得显著成功，但将其适配于对时间至事件结果进行建模以完成生存分析并非易事，原因在于右删失问题的存在，即数据观测可能在感兴趣的事件发生之前就已结束。在本工作中，我们系统地研究了多种方法，利用原本为分类任务设计的现成表格基础模型进行离散时间生存建模。我们评估了现有的分类建模方式，包括风险建模和多分类方法，并提出了一种新的建模方式：直接对离散化时间点上的累积失效概率进行建模，将删失观测视为在某些时间点上标签缺失的样本。我们证明了在标准删失假设下，随着训练集规模的增大，最小化加权交叉熵损失能够恢复真实的生存概率。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新方法，使表格基础模型通过直接建模离散化时间点的累积失效概率、将删失观测视为标签缺失样本来处理右删失数据，并从理论上证明加权交叉熵损失可恢复真实生存概率，从而成功将表格基础模型应用于生存分析。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a new formulation that enables tabular foundation models to perform survival analysis by directly modeling cumulative failure probabilities at discretized time points, treating censored observations as samples with missing labels, and proves that minimizing weighted cross-entropy loss recovers the true survival probabilities.
